name: Multi-post campaigns
description: Readiness for the multi-post campaigns feature: the C1 fixture harness, the campaign data layer (create/attach/suggest/approve), the session and shape stages, and the campaign-loop e2e spec on the production build. The C2 campaign-to-series bridge is declared but its suite does not exist yet on this branch — it reports ABSENT and feeds the build list until the bridge PR lands.

fixtures.name: campaign-fixture-harness
fixtures.description: C1 helper seeding a gate-passed, materialized campaign batch in one call.

fixtures.name: queue-capacity-fixture
fixtures.description: Shared convex-test identity/ctx helpers used by the campaign suites.

criteria.name: C1 fixture harness determinism assertions hold
criteria.description: The C1 harness suite: one-call seeding of a gate-passed materialized batch, schedule ladder, gate-fingerprint staleness, idempotency of generate/materialize, and audit-event presence.

criteria.name: Campaign data-layer suite passes
criteria.description: Core campaign mutations and queries on the in-memory Convex rung, including auth and cross-brand authorization.

criteria.name: Campaign session suite passes
criteria.description: Campaign working-session stage on the in-memory Convex rung.

criteria.name: Campaign shape suite passes
criteria.description: Shape proposal/acceptance stage on the in-memory Convex rung.

criteria.name: Campaign-loop e2e boots every campaign surface
criteria.description: Playwright rung against the production build: every campaign surface boots, renders its heading, and never crashes (CI runs without a live Convex backend, per the spec's documented assertion).

criteria.name: C2 campaign-to-series bridge suite passes
criteria.description: The C2 bridge criterion: materialized campaign posts forming a reviewable series, batch approval via seriesReview, and queueRelease preparation for a campaign-driven set. The suite (and the bridge) is a pending build-list item on this branch — expect ABSENT until the bridge PR lands.
